standard.label: Standard
standard.description: Most demanding buyer and most thorough coach. Sonnet 5.5 plays the buyer, Opus 5.5 coaches, Deepgram hears you.

saver.label: Saver
saver.description: About 60% cheaper. Haiku 5.5 plays the buyer (may go a little easier on you), Sonnet 5.5 coaches, and your phone's free built-in speech recognition hears you.

levels.name: Tougher
levels.description: Be less forthcoming. Make the rep ask twice for withheld information. Interrupt sooner. Demand evidence for every claim.

levels.name: Hardest
levels.description: Raise an extra objection the rep has not prepared for. Give one-word answers to weak questions. End the call at the first sign of a pitch without discovery.
